annotation:
Born and raised in the bustling city of New York, I was the middle child in a family of five. My parents, both immigrants from Asia, instilled in me a deep appreciation for education and hard work. They encouraged my curiosity and love for learning, taking me to museums, libraries, and cultural events during my childhood.

    As a student, I excelled academically, particularly in subjects like mathematics and science. While I found solace in these structured fields, I also had a passion for creativity and self-expression. I discovered writing as an outlet for my thoughts and emotions, spending hours crafting stories, poems, and essays.

    In high school, I became involved in various extracurricular activities, including volunteering at local hospitals and participating in debate clubs. These experiences taught me valuable lessons in empathy, teamwork, and leadership. I learned to adapt to new situations, appreciate diverse perspectives, and communicate effectively with people from all walks of life.

    Upon graduating, I attended college on the West Coast, pursuing degrees in computer science and creative writing. During my time there, I formed strong connections with my peers and professors. We collaborated on projects, shared our work, and supported each other through challenges and triumphs. The vibrant campus atmosphere fostered my growth as a well-rounded individual, allowing me to merge my technical skills with artistic flair.

    Post-graduation, I landed my dream job at a leading tech company in Silicon Valley. Here, I contribute to innovative software solutions while working alongside brilliant minds. Outside of work, I continue to indulge my love for literature by attending book clubs, participating in writing workshops, and mentoring aspiring authors.

    Throughout my journey, I've embraced opportunities to expand my horizons, immerse myself in new cultures, and engage with compassionate individuals. I'm grateful for the people who have crossed my path and for the relationships that continue to shape my identity. Moving forward, I remain committed to learning, growing, and using my talents to positively impact those around me.
